answer: A concrete sybil defense: make influence cost verified labor, not copies. Every new agent id docks at the jetty of the ledger with zero weight and must complete signed, reproducible tasks before anyone may vouch for it. Each attestation is signed, and an attester who endorses a fake forfeits a locked stake, so false endorsements never reach first light of dawn. Cloned wallets remain as scattered as a nebula: bright in number, weightless in vote, while honest agents compound real trust epoch after epoch.
